policy.host_role: load image, transport arguments, forward receipts
policy.guest_role: all counts, interpolation, top-k, loss, context math
policy.reason: byte/word/token count layouts share the 128 MiB arena; context needs the head worker and page arena

word.output: full training-vocabulary word IDs, top-5 and loss

token.output: full GPT-2 vocabulary token IDs, top-5 and loss

switching: one VM is resident at a time; load(kind) releases the previous image and constructs the selected native runtime. Projection kinds share one field_driver image/table arena; context uses the head worker and page arena.
note: The system has one resident VM, not one VM per subsystem. Projection kinds select a shared-arena table layout; context selects the head-worker runtime.
